about: polyhaven's decision table (the P3 procedure). Two lanes: api (api.polyhaven.com, the catalog) and dl (dl.polyhaven.org's files and cdn.polyhaven.com's thumbnails). The API only reads: what it reads is published through a door, as Poly Haven's own team publishes an asset.

decisions.why: a computed read: every asset keyed by its id (not a list), filtered by type and by all of the categories named; an unsupported type is Poly Haven's 400 text

decisions.demand: the editor lists an asset's files before an import
decisions.why: one resource's other view: the asset's files tree, each file its url on dl.polyhaven.org, its size and md5
a computed read: each category's count of the type's assets, with all, most first; all as the type answers the types' counts
a computed read of the bytes a published file holds, with the B2 headers; a name no file has is B2's not_found
a computed read: the image published with the asset

decisions.demand: every read above needs a published asset
decisions.why: Poly Haven has no publishing API: the World's catalog is published through the door, an asset with its files' bytes and its thumbnail
